title: Federer–Fleming closure theorem in ℝ^P for degree n < P: weak limits of IM currents with locally bounded mass and boundary mass are IM (Simon 6.3.11 via 8.2, 8.3, 6.3)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with n := m + 1 < P, and let T_j (j ∈ ℕ) and T be currents in 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) such that every T_j is integer multiplicity, sup_j (M_W(T_j) + M_W(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every bounded open W ⊆ ℝ^P (masses in [0, ∞]), and T_j ⇀ T (WeaklyConvergesOn). Then T is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), m + 1 < P → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + (Ts j).boundary.massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
